newsitem.title: MEXICO: Leftist Cardenas seeks Mexico City transition team.
newsitem.headline: Leftist Cardenas seeks Mexico City transition team.

text.p: Veteran leftist Cuauhtemoc Cardenas, the first modern elected mayor of Mexico City, said on Monday the Americas' largest metropolis needs a transition team before he takes office on Dec. 5.

Cardenas, who swept to victory in elections on Sunday for the leftist Party of the Democratic Revolution (PRD), told TV network Televisa a transition team was needed for a peaceful handover of power and to discuss next year's city budget.

"It has to be a peaceful and constructive handover ... and we have to look how we are going to participate in the preparation of the 1998 budget," Cardenas said. Wrangling over next year's budget starts well ahead of his official takeover.

Previously the president chose the mayor, an influential, high-profile position with limited real power because it governs only the Federal District, the heart of the sprawling Mexico City metropolis with half of the 17 million population. Cardenas must also win presidential approval for his budget.

Mexico City's current mayor, Oscar Espinosa Villareal, suggested two weeks ago that transition teams of officials be put in place if President Ernesto Zedillo's Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) did not win the historic election.
Cardenas stressed his top priority was to prepare work programs before December, saying no project under way in the sprawling capital would be cut under his administration.
The 63-year-old son of ex-president Lazaro Cardenas said his party had identified officials "from inside and outside the current administration" to take on the challenge of running the city.

Asked if he would include non-PRD members, Cardenas said Mexico City officials would be chosen without regard to party allegiance. "But they will be people clearly identifiable as a team of change," he added.
He said he hoped to meet at the "first opportunity" with Zedillo, who congratulated him late on Sunday for his victory.
